item.tib: bshad pa'i gzhung bsgyur gnang ba'i tshig bshad nyi zer gzha' 'od gur khyim
item.coloph: zhes pa 'dus sde g.yung drung gling chen por/ mtshan nyid gsar 'dzugs bshad dgrar (grwar) nyer mkho'i slad/ mkhan slob bka' nan ldog med shing rtas bskul/ rtsom pa'i byed po nyi ri shel zhi (bzhin) no/ tha tshan mu tsug smar ro//
